prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: ONE standalone square combat action icon for RainShadow, to replace Flee Combat.
Reference image: supplied atlas is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY. Match its black and grey ink-wash silhouettes, visible brush grain and diluted pigment gradients. Do not recreate the atlas.
Subject: an open arched doorway, with one bold horizontal arrow pointing RIGHT, exiting the doorway. A simple fantasy doorway outline on the left, pale empty doorway interior, arrow shaft crosses the opening toward a large unmistakable arrowhead outside on the right. Readable at 40 pixels. Communicate escape / leave combat. No person, no full body, no footsteps, no weapons.
Composition: one centered compact symbol occupying about 80 percent of a square canvas, generous even margins. Doorway and arrow must remain distinct with clear white gaps. Mostly bold black/charcoal brush strokes, some medium grey watery ink facets. Pure white background (#FFFFFF) and white negative space, no parchment texture (the game supplies parchment). No text, letters, border, drop shadow, bevel, colored gradients or decorative scenery.
rendering: Existing ink-density shader removes white and retains ink-wash density on parchment. Flee uses standalone glyph 20 in human and bear form; Dash retains atlas glyph 15.
